principles: Default behavior should create useful learning health data, not rely on a remembered env var.
DONE settlement must remain learning-only, non-gate, and non-blocking.
Do not turn historical backfill or active playbook promotion into hidden side effects.
Preserve explicit opt-out for local experiments and rollback.
drivers: User explicitly rejected another default-off learning feature.
The existing settlement implementation is safe but not enabled by default.
The system has many proposable historical seeds but no candidate playbooks yet, so this story must not batch import them.

options.name: keep-env-default-off
cons: Does not solve the user problem
Future DONE stories still produce no settlement data unless someone remembers the flag

options.name: default-on-settlement-with-opt-out
pros: Future DONE stories automatically leave learning health data
Preserves explicit opt-out and non-blocking behavior
Does not infer helped or import history
cons: Writes one extra learning health row per DONE story

options.name: default-on-plus-historical-backfill
cons: Could create noisy candidates before live settlement proof exists

rationale: This directly fixes the real closure bug while preserving safety and deferring historical backfill until live settlement data is proven.

preMortem.scenario: DONE settlement rows are mistaken for helped evidence
preMortem.trigger: Aggregator includes verdictSource done-settlement as helped or decisive
preMortem.consequence: Weak candidates could be promoted from DONE success alone
preMortem.mitigation: Keep existing B-7ee1 exclusion tests and add/retain smoke coverage.

preMortem.trigger: Learning store lock or append failure propagates through story_advance DONE
preMortem.mitigation: Keep try/catch, timeout, and non-blocking failed settlement result.

preMortem.scenario: Historical backfill sneaks into this story
preMortem.trigger: Implementation tries to approve candidates while changing settlement defaults
preMortem.consequence: Large noisy data mutation without live proof
preMortem.mitigation: Scope boundary excludes historical backfill and candidate approval.
